Class QuantLinearFactory

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.quant.QuantLinearFactory
public final class QuantLinearFactory extends Object
Factory for LinearOp backends from checkpoint tensors + selected backend.

    • marlinFromGptq

      public static LinearOp marlinFromGptq(Tensor qweight, Tensor scales, Tensor qzeros, Tensor gIdx, int groupSize, Device device)
      Packs GPTQ tensors and builds MarlinLinear (Ampere/Ada only). Uses direct GPTQ→Marlin pack (act-order checkpoints fail fast).
      Parameters:
      qweight - GPTQ packed weights.
      scales - group scales.
      qzeros - packed zeros, or null.
      gIdx - GPTQ g_idx, or null.
      groupSize - quantization group size.
      device - destination device.
      Returns:
      Marlin linear op.
